Dwell — Housing

Warp

Terraced housing formed by warping a base grid around program points.

→

A residential building for downtown Orlando holding 500 residences. The design warps a base grid around program points, creating terraces and public spaces at different scales — an exploration of the interaction between private and public space, and of prefabricated construction methods.

LocationDowntown Orlando, Florida
TypeResidential — 500 units
StatusAcademic project
